candidates.name: Bathymetric Attributed Grid (BAG)
verified_facts: OGC BAG represents bathymetric data as regular grids of seafloor depth together with vertical uncertainty and associated metadata.
BAG is intended for conveying and archiving bathymetry, uncertainty and metadata.
semantic_limits: A bathymetric depth grid is not an inland bare-earth parcel DTM substitute; vertical sign convention, datum, domain and uncertainty must be validated before any cross-domain elevation use.

candidates.name: OGC Table Joining Service
verified_facts: OGC Table Joining Service defines a way to describe and exchange tabular data containing information about geographic objects.
The service supports joining tabular information to geographic objects through defined identifiers and interfaces.
semantic_limits: A successful identifier/table join does not validate the target geometry, terrain sampling, vertical datum or accuracy of a parcel height result.
